facts.fact: 开罗这一趟彻底落空，是本章的开场判词
BUTTONFLY 派来的对接人 VESUVIUS 根本没到场
facts.anchor: BUTTONFLY’s guy Vito J. VESUVIUS was a total no-show.

facts.fact: KRAY 在 Café St. Germain 拿着黄色文件夹枯等了一个半小时
facts.anchor: he sat there with his yellow file folder for a good hour and a half

facts.fact: VESUVIUS 赴约途中疑心被跟踪，于是取消了会面，而他确实被跟踪了
facts.anchor: he thought he spotted surveillance following him, so he aborted

facts.fact: VESUVIUS 在亚历山大已培养了四个月的朝鲜线人
facts.anchor: had been developing a North Korean up in Alexandria for four months

facts.fact: KRAY 在露天博物馆假借系鞋带，把刻着荷鲁斯的石块塞进袜子
facts.anchor: slipped the artifact into his sock

facts.fact: KRAY 在吉萨大金字塔一带逛了三个小时，被小贩反复兜售
facts.anchor: He spent three hours there wandering around

facts.fact: KRAY 沿花岗岩爬上门卡乌拉金字塔顶，从日落待到暮色散尽
facts.anchor: he stayed until the crepuscule had long since faded

facts.fact: VESUVIUS 被总部紧急撤出埃及，据他自己说藏在汽车后备箱里用吸管呼吸逃出
facts.anchor: VESUVIUS, he got out of Egypt in the trunk of a car, breathing through a straw.
